description: Reason-code dictionary for the two-round screening ledger. Each row in screening_log carries one code; criteria_id links the code to an E1-E5 eligibility clause (null means the code is procedural and not an eligibility criterion).

codes.text: Duplicate DOI or normalised title; the first occurrence is retained.
No title or abstract text is supplied, so eligibility cannot be judged.
Publication year falls outside the declared window.
Language is outside the declared language set.
No review-question term appears in the title/abstract, so population or topic mismatches.
Study design is outside the declared eligible designs.
Full text is required by the protocol but no full text or body text is available.
No abstract is available, so outcome data cannot be read for eligibility.
All applicable criteria were met; the record enters synthesis.
